```python
import polars as pl

# Create first DataFrame with id and name
df1 = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David"]
})

# Create second DataFrame with id and amount
df2 = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [2, 3, 4, 5],
    "amount": [100, 200, 300, 400]
})

# Inner join on id to keep only matching rows
result = df1.join(df2, on="id", how="inner")

print(result)
```
